selection_disclosure: V2 collected option surfaces but found zero eligible Polymarket targets. V3 begins a fresh cohort and admits every resolver-certified BTC/ETH daily threshold strictly inside a listed Deribit expiry bracket.

target_rules.contracts: BTC and ETH daily threshold markets with an explicit Binance BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT Close rule whose named one-minute or one-hour candle interval is preserved exactly
target_rules.fidelity_a: target timestamp exactly equals a listed Deribit expiry
target_rules.fidelity_b: target timestamp is strictly bounded by listed lower and upper expiries and total variance is interpolated
rejected: unknown fee schedule or minimum order size

model.uncertainty: Deribit bid/ask IV plus resolver-basis interval
model.benchmark: executable Polymarket ask after 2x fees, depth and perpetual hedge stress
model.diagnostic: persist option fair minus contemporaneous Polymarket midpoint as the surface residual

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across asset, side, fidelity and expiry band
evaluation.null_outcome: A well-calibrated option surface may add no tradable residual beyond the prediction-market quote.
